contract:
State: round 1 (0c4fd73) verified: pnpm test 6 files 83 passed, typecheck clean, src has no I/O and no 150 literal. Reviewer: 1 blocking, 2 major (one fixed here, one deferred to a separate issue), 3 minor.

Coordinator decisions (these amend the round-1 evaluation rules):
A. playedEval source (fixes BLOCKING finding, detector.ts:34). If the played move is the first move of any line in before.lines (multi-PV), playedEval = that line score from the mover view (same search as bestEval, no drift). Otherwise playedEval = after.lines[0] as before. Consequence: playing before.bestMove always gives loss 0, so never missed_win/player_blunder/punish_opponent. Apply to opponent moves too (punish_opponent). Probe to pin: FEN r1bqkbnr/pppp1ppp/2n5/4p3/4P3/5N2/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKB1R w KQkq - 2 3, playerColor w, move f1b5, before.bestMove f1b5, before cp(300) / after cp(100) currently returns missed_win played Bb5 best Bb5; must return null. Same with before cp(30) / after cp(-150) (currently player_blunder).
B. Decided mates (major, score.ts:22). If bestEval-source score and playedEval-source score are both mate scores with the same sign (the same side is mating before and after), return null for player_blunder, missed_win and punish_opponent (opponent_left_book still applies). Replace the test "a slower mate (2 -> 4) ... fires" with one asserting null. Mate for the mover turning into a cp score or into mate for the other side still fires as before.
C. Not in this round: scaling thresholds in already-won positions (+1200 -> +1040 = missed_win). Leave the behaviour as is; it is being filed as a separate issue.

Minor fixes:
1. repertoire.ts:40: line = the first matching line that still has a continuation; if none has one, the first matching line. Probe: lines [Short "1. e4 e5 2. Nf3", Italian "1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4"], history e2e4 e7e5 g1f3, opponent f7f6 -> line must be "Italian".
2. moves.ts:13: a UCI move with a promotion suffix that is not a promotion (e.g. e2e4q from the start) must throw.
3. Tests for scoreToCp mate 0 (with and without sideToMove) and the -0 normalisation.
